# 成唯識論掌中樞要

**ID:** T1831
**Volume:** T43
**Category:** 瑜伽部類
**Original Category:** 論疏部
**Byline:** 唐 窺基撰
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 632–682
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1831

## Contributors
- 窺基 (A001019)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle topical compendium by [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) on the *Chéng wéishí lùn* ([KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016), T31n1585), distinct from the lemma-by-lemma [KR6n0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0026) *Chéng wéishí lùn shùjì* and from the lost full-length *shū* 疏. The "*zhǎng zhōng shū yào*" 掌中樞要 ("pivotal essentials in the palm of the hand") title indicates a portable doctrinal handbook: it presents the Cí'ēnzōng's principal doctrinal positions (the eight consciousnesses, the three natures, the *amala-vijñāna* polemic, the bodhisattva-bhūmi system) in topical rather than textual order, designed for memorisation and oral exposition.

**Abstract**

The *zhǎngzhōng shūyào* is the third of [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA)'s three principal commentaries on the *Chéng wéishí lùn*: alongside the lemma-by-lemma [KR6n0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0026) *shùjì* and the lost full *shū* 疏 (mentioned in [KR2m0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR2/KR2m/KR2m0019) *Sòng gāosēng zhuàn* T2061, j. 4), the *shūyào* serves as the introductory and topical-encyclopedic counterpart. Together with [KR6n0030](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0030) *Chéng wéishí lùn liǎoyì dēng* (T1832) by Huìzhāo and [KR6n0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0032) *Chéng wéishí lùn yǎnmì* (T1833) by Zhìzhōu, it constitutes the canonical Cí'ēn "three commentaries" (*sān shū* 三疏) of the early Tang.

The dating window adopted (659–682) covers Kuījī's productive teaching period from the publication of the master text through to his death.

The work was a standard textbook for Hossō study in Heian Japan and is referenced in nearly every Japanese sub-commentary on the *Chéng wéishí lùn*. The companion text [KR6n0035](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0035) *Chéng wéishí lùn zhǎngzhōng shūyào jì* (X49n0810) by Zhìzhōu is the principal sub-commentary.
